name: Tenri (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tenri city emblem in white: an outlined plum blossom enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tenri, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 September 1954.

features.role: Tenri city emblem — an outlined plum blossom enclosing a ring
